entities.summary: Mohammad Abdullah Mohammad Mustafa is a Palestinian politician and economist who has served as Prime Minister of Palestine since 31 March 2024. He previously served as the Chairman of the Board of the Palestine Investment Fund (PIF), Senior Economic Advisor to President Mahmoud Abbas and an Independent member of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organization. Previously, he had served as Deputy Prime Minister of Palestine and as Minister of National Economy of Palestine.
